description: Agent Negotiation: submit an original offer and a counteroffer, each with its terms as written, and the mandate limits the counter is read against: each limit with its term, direction (at most, at least or exactly) and value, and the terms that may not change. The signed report reads every term of the counter as kept, changed or added, and against each limit on it as an amount, date, span, percentage, count or exact text, and names every limit crossed and every fixed term changed or dropped, then every original term the counter drops without a word, every new term with no limit and every change with no limit, with the fix for each. Two contract versions are wever_contract-diff-check, quotes for one job are wever_quote-compare and the mandate’s own bounds are wever_negotiation-mandate-check. A worked sample is wever_negotiation-playbook-sample on https://weverlabs.com/mcp-free. Verdict counter_crosses_mandate, counter_gaps, counter_unverified or counter_within_mandate. POST /api/negotiation-counteroffer-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-negotiation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-negotiation/.
